tools.name: search_hotels
tools.description: Find HotelShortlist research pages for hotels by hotel name or city. Returns page links; each page shows the review findings and the analysis date.

tools.name: get_membership_info
tools.description: What HotelShortlist membership costs, how the fee works and how the research is made.

tools.name: list_pitch_lanes
tools.description: The offers for travellers, tour operators, travel designers and agents, hotel owners and hotel chains, with links and WhatsApp contact.

tools.name: start_membership_application
tools.description: The link and steps for applying for membership. The person applies themselves; this tool submits nothing.

tools.name: request_introduction
tools.description: Send HotelShortlist a request to get in touch. Only call this when the person asked for it and explicitly agreed to share these details. A person at HotelShortlist replies.

tools.name: request_hotel_page
tools.description: Ask HotelShortlist to research a hotel that search_hotels did not find. The research takes about a minute: call again with the same hotel and city to get the page link. Pages show the review findings; member rates stay for members.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_hotels, request_hotel_page · Private data: list_pitch_lanes · Public sink: request_introduction.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_hotels, request_hotel_page · Private data: list_pitch_lanes · Public sink: request_introduction

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
